reason: A local persistent memory layer for DeepSeek Harness that records project knowledge, retrieves relevant history, injects bounded hot memory into future sessions, and provides a management panel.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地持久化项目记忆，支持记录经验、相关检索、跨会话有限注入以及通过 Web 面板管理记忆。
summaries.en: Provides local persistent project memory for DeepSeek Harness with experience recording, ranked retrieval, bounded cross-session injection, and Web-based memory management.

capabilities: Persists project and global memory entries in local JSON and Markdown files
Injects bounded selected memory into future agent system prompts
Provides local ranked retrieval of stored memories
Provides a Web GUI and API routes for browsing, searching, editing, and deleting memories
Automatically reminds agents to distill work after configured turns
